lines.text: Moses recites a song to all Israel, wants his teaching to fall like rain, and calls the LORD the Rock.
The LORD found Jacob in a howling wilderness and, like an eagle, spread His wings to catch him.
Jeshurun grew fat and abandoned God, and they sacrificed to angels, gods they had not known.
One man could chase a thousand only if the LORD gave them up; their vine is from Sodom and Admah.
God says there is no God besides Him, and the song ends with the nations rejoicing with His people.
